neighbours.label: subject of a research-findings report, just before its verb (study results were / researchers looked)
fire: In the new survey, the results of the trial were clear about sleep and memory.
The team's latest findings, published in a medical journal, link diet to mood.
When scientists examined the blood samples, they found higher iron levels.
The results of the experiment were consistent across all age groups.
According to the paper, the investigators measured stress in two hundred adults.
The study's main findings were replicated in a second cohort.
When the researchers compared the two groups, the difference was small.
Their new data, collected over ten years, show a steady decline in bees.
quiet: In the new kitchen, the cupboards of the house were painted bright blue.
The team's latest jerseys, sold in a sports shop, are bright red.
When the children opened the presents, they found new bicycles.
The windows of the old school were broken during the storm.
According to the menu, the restaurant serves fish on Fridays.
The club's main members were invited to a second dinner.
When the neighbours painted the two fences, the colour was green.
Their new car, bought over the weekend, has a steady engine.

notes: Card: 'results of the study were', 'The team's new results,', 'The findings to date', 'When researchers looked'. + pole is 'Legend has it / theory tells us / Statistics have shown' and promotes says/shows/suggests.
